notes: Standard VAT 20% (PwC). Investment gold VAT-exempt under Art. 346, Directive 2006/112/EC. Tavex BG, 27 Nov 2026: 1 g house bar sell 123 EUR, buy 111 EUR = 9.8% buyback discount. Prices dual-displayed EUR/BGN before euro adoption (1 Jan 2026). No primary-page spot read, so premiums empty; duty, making, used-gold null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Bulgaria, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: The standard VAT rate is 20%; customs duties are calculated in accordance with the EU customs tariff (no gold-specific duty rate stated).

sources.name: Council Directive 2006/112/EC, Chapter 5 - Special scheme for investment gold, Art. 346
sources.what: Member States shall exempt from VAT the supply, intra-Community acquisition and importation of investment gold (bars/wafers of purity >= 995 thousandths) - gold vatBullionPct 0.

sources.name: Tavex Bulgaria - 1 g Tavex Gold Bar
sources.what: Dealer's own prices read 27 Nov 2026: We sell 123.00 EUR / We buy 111.00 EUR, stated spread 9.76% - bar buyback discount typical 9.8%. Prices dual-displayed in EUR and BGN.
